text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Dream Journey finishes in 1st place!
She's strong! An unshakable, dominant display!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you all very much
for your cheers again today.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "I will continue my adjustments for the Arima Kinen, so—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to hold high expectations.
For my back-to-back Grand Prix victories—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—...Our "journey" is finally
approaching a major milestone, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
choice_data_list: I'm just really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
......No, in this case, perhaps I should say
the path is falling into place.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Then, let us enjoy
the rest of the road leading up to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Because that's just the way a "journey" goes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The end of the road merges with the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It is as though one walks toward the gold.
A scenery that brings a sense of the end,"
the traveler whispered to the grass and leaves—
